(Tools: Glob, Grep, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- Explore: Fast read-only search agent for locating code. Use it to find files by pattern (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), grep for symbols or keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer "where is X defined / which files reference Y." Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. When calling, specify search breadth: "quick" for a single targeted lookup, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" to search across multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. ## claude-in-chrome
**IMPORTANT: If the Chrome browser tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load them with ToolSearch before calling them, and batch every tool you expect to need into ONE ToolSearch call (the select query accepts a comma-separated list). Do NOT load tools one at a time; each separate ToolSearch call wastes a full round-trip.**

Start a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:

ToolSearch with query "select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp"

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting. Only issue a second ToolSearch if the task later needs a tool you did not anticipate.

---README---
# KasirKu

POS kasir untuk F&B dan Retail. Next.js (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind) + Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage).

Migrasi dari prototype single-file HTML/localStorage — lihat referensi lengkap logika bisnis & rencana skema di [`docs/reference/`](docs/reference/).

## Struktur project

```
src/
  app/                  routes (App Router)
  lib/
    supabase/
      client.ts          Supabase client untuk Client Components (browser)
      server.ts           Supabase client untuk Server Components/Actions (cookies)
      middleware.ts        refresh session token, dipanggil dari src/proxy.ts
    types/
      database.ts          tipe hasil `supabase gen types typescript` (masih placeholder)
supabase/
  config.toml             konfigurasi Supabase CLI lokal
  migrations/              schema database, urut sesuai modul (lihat di bawah)
docs/
  reference/
    pos-system_1.html       prototype asli (referensi logika bisnis, JANGAN dijalankan sebagai app)
    skema-database-kasirku.md   dokumen perencanaan skema
```

## Setup

1. Install dependencies (sudah dijalankan saat scaffold, ulangi kalau clone baru):
   ```bash
   npm install
   ```
2. Buat project di [supabase.com](https://supabase.com/dashboard), lalu salin `.env.example` ke `.env.local` dan isi `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` dari Project Settings → API.
3. Link project lokal ke project Supabase yang baru dibuat:
   ```bash
   npx supabase login
   npx supabase link --project-ref <project-ref>
   ```
4. Jalankan migration ke database Supabase:
   ```bash
   npx supabase db push
   ```
   Atau, untuk development lokal dengan Docker (`supabase start` butuh Docker Desktop):
   ```bash
   npx supabase start
   npx supabase db reset   # apply semua migration ke instance lokal
   ```
5. Generate TypeScript types dari schema yang sudah jalan (menggantikan placeholder di `src/lib/types/database.ts`):
   ```bash
   npx supabase gen types typescript --project-id <project-ref> > src/lib/types/database.ts
   ```
6. Jalankan dev server:
   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```

## Urutan migration

Mengikuti urutan modul di `docs/reference/skema-database-kasirku.md`:

1. `20260702100000_extensions_and_helpers.sql` — extension pgcrypto, skema `private`, helper RLS `private.owns_business()`
2. `20260702100100_businesses_and_cashiers.sql` — fondasi auth & akses
3. `20260702100200_products_ingredients_recipes.sql` — data master
4. `20260702100300_shifts_and_transactions.sql` — inti operasional
5. `20260702100400_finance_tables.sql` — modul Keuangan
6. `20260702100500_fnb_support_tables.sql` — fitur pendukung F&B (juga menyambungkan FK `transactions.table_id` yang sengaja ditunda dari migration #4, karena tabel `tables` baru ada di sini)
7. `20260702100600_activity_log.sql` — log aktivitas

Setiap tabel dengan `business_id` diamankan dengan RLS lewat `private.owns_business(business_id)` — akses hanya untuk businesses milik `auth.uid()` yang sedang login. Tabel anak yang tidak punya `business_id` langsung (`product_recipes`, `transaction_items`, dll) diamankan lewat `EXISTS` join ke tabel induknya.

## Keputusan desain yang masih perlu diambil

Belum diimplementasikan di migration ini — perlu diputuskan sebelum modul terkait mulai di-porting:

- **Verifikasi PIN kasir**: RLS `cashiers` saat ini hanya mengizinkan `owner_id = auth.uid()` (pemilik akun) membaca `pin_hash`. Karena kasir individual tidak punya akun Supabase Auth sendiri (hanya pemilik bisnis yang login), verifikasi PIN sebaiknya lewat Postgres function (`security definer` RPC) yang menerima `cashier_id` + PIN plaintext dan mengembalikan boolean — supaya `pin_hash` tidak perlu ter-expose ke client sama sekali.
- **Self-order dari pelanggan (scan QR meja)**: pelanggan yang scan QR di meja tidak login sebagai pemilik bisnis, jadi policy `private.owns_business()` pada `self_orders`/`self_order_items` akan memblokir mereka melakukan INSERT. Perlu policy tambahan yang scoped ke `anon` role (misalnya izinkan INSERT kalau `table_id` valid & `self_orders.status = 'baru'`), atau proses lewat Edge Function dengan service role.
- **Tutup shift**: kalkulasi `cash_sales`/`non_cash_sales`/`total_sales`/`expected_cash`/`difference` sebaiknya jadi Postgres function (RPC) supaya atomic, bukan dihitung di client lalu di-`UPDATE` — sesuai catatan di dokumen skema asli.

## Urutan migrasi modul (disarankan)

Jangan migrasi semua sekaligus. Urutan yang masuk akal berdasarkan ketergantungan data:

1. `businesses`, `cashiers` — fondasi auth & akses
2. `products`, `ingredients`, `product_recipes` — data master, paling jarang berubah strukturnya
3. `shifts`, `transactions`, `transaction_items`, `transaction_payments` — inti operasional
4. `expenses`, `inventory_snapshots`, `reconciliations`, `merchant_fees` — modul Keuangan
5. `tables`, `self_orders`, `kitchen_printers`, `custom_payment_methods` — fitur pendukung F&B
6. `activity_log` — bisa belakangan, tidak kritikal untuk operasional harian

Di tiap tahap: bangun, uji dengan data dummy, baru migrasikan data asli dari backup JSON yang sudah ada sebelum lanjut ke modul berikutnya.

---

## Yang sengaja belum dibahas di dokumen ini

- Skrip migrasi data dari backup JSON localStorage ke database (perlu dibuat terpisah, setelah skema ini final)
- Desain API/RPC calls spesifik (kalau pakai Supabase, sebagian besar bisa lewat client SDK langsung + RLS, tapi kalkulasi kompleks seperti "tutup shift" mungkin lebih aman sebagai Postgres function/RPC supaya atomic)
- Setup CI/CD dan environment staging vs production

Dokumen ini adalah titik awal perencanaan — detail lebih lanjut sebaiknya dikembangkan di Claude Code, di mana skema ini bisa langsung dieksekusi jadi migration files sungguhan.

| **Produk & Bahan Baku** | CRUD, resep, kalkulasi HPP dari resep, stok opname, soft delete, notifikasi stok rendah |
| **Meja/Self-order** | QR meja, layar order pelanggan, status pesanan, masuk ke cart kasir |

options.label: Nomor seri per transaksi
options.description: Setiap transaksi kasir otomatis dapat nomor seri tiket tambahan (di luar invoice_number yang sudah ada), misal untuk keperluan undian/kupon.

options.label: Tiket fisik pra-cetak (buku tiket)
options.description: Ada buku/roll tiket fisik dengan rentang nomor seri (misal 00001-00100) yang harus diinput manual saat transaksi, untuk rekonsiliasi penjualan vs tiket yang dipakai.

options.label: Tiket = produk/item terpisah
options.description: Tiket adalah semacam produk khusus (misal tiket masuk/parkir) yang dijual seperti item POS biasa, dan tiap unit dapat nomor seri sendiri.

questions.question: Bagaimana hubungan member dengan tiket bernomor seri ini?

options.label: Terpisah, dua laporan berbeda
options.description: Jumlah member (total customer terdaftar) dan penjualan-per-tiket adalah dua angka/laporan independen, tidak saling terkait langsung.

options.label: Tiket dikaitkan ke member pembeli
options.description: Tiap tiket bisa (opsional) dikaitkan ke satu member/customer, jadi bisa dilihat member mana pakai tiket nomor berapa.

options.label: Hanya member yang bisa dapat tiket bernomor seri
options.description: Tiket bernomor seri khusus ini eksklusif untuk transaksi member, transaksi non-member tidak dapat nomor seri.

questions.question: Format nomor seri tiketnya seperti apa?

options.label: Auto-increment sistem
options.description: Sistem generate otomatis, urut per bisnis (misal berdasarkan counter), tidak bisa diedit manual.

options.label: Input manual oleh kasir
options.description: Kasir ketik/scan nomor seri dari tiket fisik yang dipegang saat transaksi.

options.label: Prefix + counter per periode
options.description: Format seperti TKT-2026-000123, reset atau lanjut per bulan/tahun, digenerate otomatis tapi dengan format khusus.

This is a Next.js + Supabase POS app called KasirKu at G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu. The `businesses` table has a `business_type` column constrained to `check (business_type in ('fnb', 'retail'))` (see supabase/migrations/20260702100100_businesses_and_cashiers.sql).

I'm planning to add a THIRD business type for venue/attraction ticketing (kolam renang, playground, tempat wisata) — a completely different POS model based on selling numbered tickets (not products), with two ticket categories (pengunjung/visitor and penunggu/companion), weekday vs weekend/holiday pricing, and a paid membership system (members get special ticket pricing, tied to a validity period).

I need to understand, for planning purposes:

1. **Onboarding flow**: Find where business_type is selected/set when a new business is created (search src/app/onboarding/). What does the UI look like — a picker between fnb/retail? How is business_type stored and read afterward?

2. **Where business_type gates behavior**: grep the whole src/ tree for `business_type` and `businessType` to find every place code branches on it (e.g. showing/hiding "ingredients" nav item for retail vs fnb, or the pos-screen.tsx). List each file + what it does differently per type.

3. **Dashboard layout / navigation**: Find the sidebar/nav component (likely under src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/ or src/components/) that lists nav items (products, ingredients, tables, shifts, payroll, etc.) — understand how nav items are conditionally shown, so I can figure out how a new "tiket" business type would swap in different nav items (e.g. hide products/ingredients/tables, show tickets/members instead).

4. **POS screen entry point**: Read src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/page.tsx and pos-screen.tsx briefly (just enough to understand structure: how it fetches products, cart state, checkout call) — I want to know whether it's feasible to have this same route render a totally different UI when business_type is a new 'tiket' value, or whether a separate route/screen would be cleaner.

5. **Database types**: check src/lib/types/database.ts — is it hand-maintained or generated? Does it already reflect the current schema accurately (I noticed the README calls it "masih placeholder" — is that still true)?

Report back with file paths, relevant code snippets (short), and a clear picture of: how business_type currently branches behavior, and what the cleanest insertion point would be for a new business type with its own nav items and its own POS screen. Keep the report focused and under 500 words of prose (code snippets don't count against that).

### 1. **Onboarding Flow** 
**Location:** `src/app/onboarding/onboarding-form.tsx` & `src/app/onboarding/actions.ts`

The onboarding UI presents a **radio button picker** with two options (fnb, retail). The form collects:
- `name` (business name)
- `business_type` (radio input: "fnb" or "retail")

In `actions.ts`, validation explicitly checks: `if (businessType !== "fnb" && businessType !== "retail")` — you'll need to add "tiket" here and update the constraint in the database.

The value is stored directly to the `businesses` table as-is.

---

### 2. **Where Business Type Gates Behavior**

Grep found 8 files using `business_type` or `isFnb`:

| File | What It Does |
|------|-------------|
| **`layout.tsx`** (dashboard layout) | Converts `business.business_type === "fnb"` to boolean `isFnb`, passes to `DashboardShell` to control nav rendering. |
| **`pos/page.tsx`** | Fetches business data including `business_type`, sets `isFnb`, passes to `PosScreen`. FnB polls for self-orders every 15s; retail doesn't. |
| **`pos/pos-screen.tsx`** (1328 lines) | Uses `isFnb` prop. If true: displays self-orders inbox, open bills, table QR ordering; if false: simpler retail UI. Checkout logic is shared. |
| **`tables/page.tsx`** | **Gated entirely by FnB**: `if (!business \|\| business.business_type !== "fnb") notFound()` — retail can't access. |
| **`ingredients/page.tsx`** | FnB-only feature (implied by nav logic). |
| **`settings/page.tsx`** (line 28) | `isFnb` determines whether kitchen printers section renders. |
| **`finance/page.tsx`** (line 90) | `isFnb` affects COGS calculations and reconciliation logic. |
| **`dashboard/page.tsx`** | Lists all businesses; displays type badge; nav items below each business card conditionally show "Bahan Baku" link only for FnB. |

---

### 3. **Dashboard Navigation Structure**

**Location:** `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/dashboard-shell.tsx` (lines 11–54)

The nav is built by `buildNavGroups(businessId: string, isFnb: boolean)`:

```
- Keuangan (Finance)
  - Dashboard, Laporan, Laba Rugi, Keuangan, Riwayat Transaksi, Riwayat Shift
- Operasional (Operations)
  - Kelola Produk
  - [Bahan Baku, Meja & Self-Order] ← only if isFnb
  - Pelanggan
- SDM (HR)
  - Kelola Kasir, Absensi, Payroll
- Lainnya (Other)
  - Pengaturan, Aktivitas
```

**For a new "tiket" type, you'd:**
- Modify `buildNavGroups()` to accept a `businessType` enum (or keep `isFnb` and add `isTicketing`)
- Swap out "Operasional" nav items:
  - Hide: Kelola Produk, Bahan Baku, Meja & Self-Order
  - Add: Tiket, Anggota (Members), Harga Tiket

---

### 4. **POS Screen Entry Point**

**Location:** `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/page.tsx` (server component) + `pos-screen.tsx` (client)

**Current structure:**
1. Server fetches business, cashier session, shift, **products** (hardcoded for product-based sales)
2. If FnB: also fetches open_bills, self_orders
3. Client component `PosScreen` receives `isFnb` prop to swap UI

**Feasibility assessment:**
- The **server page.tsx has tight coupling to products/items**. For a ticket system (no products, just ticket categories), you have **two clean options:**

  - `/business/[businessId]/pos` → product-based (FnB/retail)
  - `/business/[businessId]/tiket` → ticket sales (new)
  - Keep POS screens fully separate, each optimized for their domain
  
  **Option B (Unified but more refactor):** 
  - Generalize `pos/page.tsx` to fetch **either** products or tickets based on type
  - Pass discriminated union to `PosScreen` and render conditionally
  - Higher cohesion but more complex branch logic

**Recommendation:** **Option A** — simpler, avoids bloating POS with conditional ticket logic, makes testing/maintenance easier.

---

### 5. **Database Types**

**File:** `src/lib/types/database.ts` (3 lines)

It's currently **placeholder**:
```typescript
export type Database = Record<string, never>;
```

With comment: "_masih placeholder_" — regenerate after migrations via:
```bash
npx supabase gen types typescript --project-id <ref> > src/lib/types/database.ts
```

**Action item:** After you add the "tiket" migration (products/tickets/members tables + constraint), regenerate this.

---

For adding "tiket" business type:

1. **Schema constraint** (priority 1):
   - Edit `supabase/migrations/20260702100100_businesses_and_cashiers.sql`
   - Change: `check (business_type in ('fnb', 'retail'))` → `check (business_type in ('fnb', 'retail', 'tiket'))`
   - Create new migration for tickets/members tables

2. **Onboarding UI & validation** (priority 2):

   - Update validation in `onboarding/actions.ts`

3. **Navigation branching** (priority 3):
   - Update `buildNavGroups()` signature in `dashboard-shell.tsx`
   - Add conditional nav groups for `businessType === 'tiket'`

4. **POS entry point** (priority 4):
   - Create `/business/[businessId]/tiket/page.tsx` (separate server page)
   - Create `/business/[businessId]/tiket/tiket-screen.tsx` (client component)
   - Route link in `dashboard-shell.tsx` (top POS button shows different link per type)

5. **Business display** (priority 5):
   - Update badge in `dashboard/page.tsx` to show "🎟️ Venue / Ticketing"

The architecture already cleanly separates concerns via `isFnb`/`business_type` branching, so adding a third type is low-risk — just follow the same conditional pattern.</result>

content.content:
-- Module 12: void transaksi sebagai satu RPC atomik. Hanya manajer (via PIN,
-- diverifikasi terhadap pin_hash di database) yang boleh membatalkan.
-- Stok produk dikembalikan dari transaction_items, dan stok bahan baku
-- dikembalikan dari snapshot transaction_ingredient_consumption — persis
-- kebalikan dari checkout_transaction.

create or replace function public.void_transaction(
  p_business_id uuid,
  p_transaction_id uuid,
  p_manager_pin text,
  p_reason text default null
)
returns table (voided_by_name text)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_manager record;
  v_tx record;
begin
  if not private.owns_business(p_business_id) then
    raise exception 'not authorized';
  end if;

  -- Hanya PIN milik manajer aktif dari bisnis ini yang diterima. Pesan error
  -- sengaja tidak membedakan "PIN salah" vs "bukan manajer".
  select c.id, c.name
  into v_manager
  from public.cashiers c
  where c.business_id = p_business_id
    and c.role = 'manajer'
    and c.active
    and c.pin_hash = extensions.crypt(p_manager_pin, c.pin_hash)
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'PIN salah atau tidak memiliki otorisasi';
  end if;

  select t.id, t.voided
  into v_tx
  from public.transactions t
  where t.id = p_transaction_id
    and t.business_id = p_business_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'transaction not found';
  end if;

  if v_tx.voided then
    raise exception 'transaksi sudah dibatalkan';
  end if;

  -- Kembalikan stok produk yang terjual (produk yang sudah dihapus dilewati,
  -- sama seperti aplikasi lama).
  update public.products p
  set stock = p.stock + ti.qty
  from public.transaction_items ti
  where ti.transaction_id = p_transaction_id
    and ti.product_id = p.id
    and p.deleted_at is null;

  -- Kembalikan stok bahan baku yang terkonsumsi resep saat checkout.
  update public.ingredients i
  set stock = i.stock + tic.qty
  from public.transaction_ingredient_consumption tic
  where tic.transaction_id = p_transaction_id
    and tic.ingredient_id = i.id;

  update public.transactions
  set voided = true,
      voided_at = now(),
      void_reason = nullif(left(trim(p_reason), 200), ''),
      voided_by = v_manager.id

-- Module 12: void transaksi sebagai satu RPC atomik. Hanya manajer (via PIN,
-- diverifikasi terhadap pin_hash di database) yang boleh membatalkan.
-- Stok produk dikembalikan dari transaction_items, dan stok bahan baku
-- dikembalikan dari snapshot transaction_ingredient_consumption — persis
-- kebalikan dari checkout_transaction.

create or replace function public.void_transaction(
  p_business_id uuid,
  p_transaction_id uuid,
  p_manager_pin text,
  p_reason text default null
)
returns table (voided_by_name text)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_manager record;
  v_tx record;
begin
  if not private.owns_business(p_business_id) then
    raise exception 'not authorized';
  end if;

  -- Hanya PIN milik manajer aktif dari bisnis ini yang diterima. Pesan error
  -- sengaja tidak membedakan "PIN salah" vs "bukan manajer".
  select c.id, c.name
  into v_manager
  from public.cashiers c
  where c.business_id = p_business_id
    and c.role = 'manajer'
    and c.active
    and c.pin_hash = extensions.crypt(p_manager_pin, c.pin_hash)
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'PIN salah atau tidak memiliki otorisasi';
  end if;

  select t.id, t.voided
  into v_tx
  from public.transactions t
  where t.id = p_transaction_id
    and t.business_id = p_business_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'transaction not found';
  end if;

  if v_tx.voided then
    raise exception 'transaksi sudah dibatalkan';
  end if;

  -- Kembalikan stok produk yang terjual (produk yang sudah dihapus dilewati,
  -- sama seperti aplikasi lama).
  update public.products p
  set stock = p.stock + ti.qty
  from public.transaction_items ti
  where ti.transaction_id = p_transaction_id
    and ti.product_id = p.id
    and p.deleted_at is null;

  -- Kembalikan stok bahan baku yang terkonsumsi resep saat checkout.
  update public.ingredients i
  set stock = i.stock + tic.qty
  from public.transaction_ingredient_consumption tic
  where tic.transaction_id = p_transaction_id
    and tic.ingredient_id = i.id;

  update public.transactions
  set voided = true,
      voided_at = now(),
      void_reason = nullif(left(trim(p_reason), 200), ''),
      voided_by = v_manager.id
  where id = p_transaction_id;

  return query select v_manager.name;
end;
$$;

input.prompt:
Design a detailed, concrete implementation plan for a new feature in the KasirKu POS app (Next.js App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind + Supabase, at G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu). Do not write code — produce a step-by-step plan with exact file paths, schema, and function signatures. I already did extensive exploration; use the facts below as ground truth rather than re-deriving them, but you may Read specific files listed below to verify exact current code before finalizing signatures.

## Feature being added
A THIRD business type, `'tiket'` (alongside existing `'fnb'` and `'retail'`), for venue/attraction ticketing (kolam renang, playground, tempat wisata). This is a distinct "kasir" model — not products, but numbered admission tickets — confirmed by the user via clarifying questions:

- Two ticket categories exist per business, configurable (not hardcoded), e.g. "Pengunjung" (visitor) and "Penunggu" (companion) — each has its OWN continuous serial-number sequence (never resets).
- Ticket price depends on day type: weekday vs "hari libur" (holiday) — holiday = Saturday/Sunday automatically, OR a manually-marked date (owner can flag specific calendar dates, e.g. national holidays, via a settings UI).
- There's a paid membership system: `members` are subscription/card-based customers (name, phone, a member code, validity period `valid_from`/`valid_until`). Members get a special ticket price per category (or free access) instead of the weekday/holiday price. A member's ticket still gets a serial number (for attendance/reconciliation tracking) — it's not a free pass with zero record.
- Ticket prices ARE subject to the business's existing tax_rate/service_rate settings (same fields already on `businesses`: tax_enabled, tax_rate, service_enabled, service_rate), same formula as the existing product checkout.
- User wants two reports: (1) total active member count, (2) sales report filterable/groupable by ticket category + serial-number range + date range, for reconciling physical ticket usage against system sales.

## Ground truth from my exploration (verified by reading the actual files)

**business_type column**: `supabase/migrations/20260702100100_businesses_and_cashiers.sql` line 7: `business_type text not null check (business_type in ('fnb', 'retail')),` — inline unnamed check constraint, so Postgres auto-names it `businesses_business_type_check`. This migration is ALREADY APPLIED to the live Supabase DB (per project convention: migrations are pasted manually into the Supabase dashboard SQL editor, no linked CLI) — so it must NOT be edited in place; a NEW migration file must ALTER the existing constraint (`drop constraint if exists businesses_business_type_check` then re-add with the third value).

**Existing generic infra that's reusable as-is for the ticket business type** (do NOT rebuild these):
- `cashiers` table + PIN auth + roles (kasir/manajer) — business-type agnostic.
- `shifts` table (open/close, opening_cash, cash_sales, etc.) — business-type agnostic, just a business_id/cashier_id relation, no product coupling.
- `attendance`, `payroll` modules — agnostic.
- POS entry flow `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/page.tsx` → `pin-screen.tsx` (PIN entry) → `open-shift-screen.tsx` (opening cash) — both fully generic, no product references, reusable verbatim. Only the final step (`pos-screen.tsx`, the actual cart/checkout UI, 1328 lines, tightly coupled to `products`) is NOT reusable for tickets — a new client component is needed for the ticket-selling screen, but it should be reached via the SAME `/business/[businessId]/pos` route (page.tsx already branches server-side on `business.business_type`; extend that branch to render a new `TicketPosScreen` instead of `PosScreen` when businessType === 'tiket', after the same PinScreen/OpenShiftScreen gates).
- Existing `checkout_transaction` RPC pattern (latest version in `supabase/migrations/20260704200000_customers.sql`, lines 40-254) is the model to mirror for a new `checkout_ticket_transaction` RPC: security definer, validates `private.owns_business()`, validates active cashier, validates active shift exists (reuses the SAME `shifts` table — no new shift concept needed), generates an invoice number via count-based sequence (existing pattern, accepted risk in this codebase), does the work in a loop, inserts a header row + child rows.
- Existing `void_transaction` RPC (`supabase/migrations/20260703100000_void_transaction_rpc.sql`) is the model for a new `void_ticket_transaction` RPC — same manager-PIN-verification-via-crypt pattern (`c.pin_hash = extensions.crypt(p_manager_pin, c.pin_hash)`), same `for update` row lock before flipping voided/voided_at/void_reason/voided_by. For tickets there's no stock to restore, just flip the flag (ticket serials stay permanently allocated even if voided, matching physical reality — a printed ticket was already handed out).
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/customers/actions.ts` and `add-customer-form.tsx`/`edit-customer-form.tsx` are the CRUD pattern to mirror for the new `members` CRUD pages (server actions with useActionState, soft delete via `deleted_at`, `revalidatePath`, `logActivity` calls — see `src/lib/activity-log.ts` usage).
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/reports/period.ts` has `parsePeriod`/`getPeriodRange`/`PERIOD_LABELS` — a WIB-timezone-aware date-range helper already used by reports pages; reuse it for the new ticket sales report's date filter instead of writing new date logic.
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/settings/tax-service-form.tsx` + `settings/actions.ts` is the pattern to mirror for a new ticket-category price management form (owner sets price_weekday/price_holiday/member_price per category) and for a holiday-date-marking UI.

**Where `business_type`/`isFnb` currently branches UI** (each needs a new branch or at least must not break for the new type):
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/layout.tsx` line ~16-28: fetches `business_type`, computes `isFnb = business.business_type === "fnb"`, passes to `DashboardShell`.
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/dashboard-shell.tsx`: `buildNavGroups(businessId, isFnb)` (lines 11-54) builds the sidebar nav array; `isFnb` also toggles a subtitle string ("Restoran / Kafe / F&B" vs "Retail / Toko") around line 90. This need to become aware of a third type to: hide "Kelola Produk"/"Pelanggan" nav items and show new "Tiket", "Kategori & Harga Tiket", "Anggota" items instead, for `businessType === 'tiket'`.
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/page.tsx` (full content already read — lines 1-164): fetches products/open_bills/customers/self_orders unconditionally, computes `isFnb`. For `'tiket'` businesses this whole product-fetching branch should be skipped and ticket_categories/members fetched instead, then render a new `TicketPosScreen`.
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/tables/page.tsx` line ~43: hard `notFound()` unless `business_type === "fnb"` — leave as-is, tiket businesses also can't access this page (correct, no change needed beyond confirming it still 404s for 'tiket' too, which it already will since it's an explicit `!== "fnb"` check... wait it needs to also exclude retail already, verify the exact condition still works for a 3-way enum).
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/settings/page.tsx` line ~28, ~41, ~115: `isFnb` toggles whether kitchen-printer settings show. Needs a new conditional section for ticket-category price management + holiday calendar when `businessType === 'tiket'`.
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/finance/page.tsx` line ~90: `isFnb` affects COGS/reconciliation math — this page queries the `transactions` table for cost-of-goods calculations, which don't apply to ticket sales (no COGS concept for admission tickets). Decide: for 'tiket' businesses, either show a simplified finance page or note this is out of scope for V1 (recommend explicitly treating general Dashboard/Laporan/Laba-Rugi/Keuangan pages as staying scoped to product-based `transactions` only, and building ticket revenue reporting as its own separate, additive report page — do NOT try to unify `transactions` and the new ticket tables inside every existing report page, that's too much scope creep for this task).
- `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/page.tsx` (main dashboard KPI cards) line ~60: queries `.from("transactions")` unconditionally for today's sales summary — for 'tiket' businesses this always shows zero. Needs a branch: if businessType === 'tiket', query ticket_transactions summary instead for the KPI cards.
- `src/app/dashboard/page.tsx` (list of all businesses) lines ~92, ~143: badge text and a conditional nav link per business_type — needs a third badge/branch.
- `src/app/onboarding/onboarding-form.tsx` (full content read, lines 1-91): radio button picker between fnb/retail — needs a third radio option for "tiket" (venue/wisata). Server-side validation lives in `src/app/onboarding/actions.ts` (`if (businessType !== "fnb" && businessType !== "retail")`) — needs updating too.

**Database types**: `src/lib/types/database.ts` is currently a placeholder (`export type Database = Record<string, never>;`), not actually used for real type inference anywhere critical — do not block the plan on regenerating it, just note that it's out of sync already (pre-existing condition, unrelated to this feature) and the new tables won't appear there either until the user manually runs `supabase gen types` against their live project (per project convention, migrations are pasted manually into the Supabase dashboard, no linked CLI in this sandbox).

## Your task
Produce a concrete implementation plan covering:
1. Exact new migration file (new timestamp after `20260706100000_payroll.sql`, e.g. `20260706200000_ticket_venue.sql`) with full schema: the constraint alter, and CREATE TABLE statements for `ticket_categories`, `members`, `ticket_holidays`, `ticket_transactions`, `ticket_serials` (one row per physical ticket — no separate line-items table needed since price+category can be snapshotted directly on each serial row), RLS policies (mirror the `private.owns_business(business_id)` pattern used everywhere else), and the two RPCs (`checkout_ticket_transaction`, `void_ticket_transaction`) with full plpgsql bodies.
2. Exact list of new page/component files to create for: ticket-selling POS screen, ticket category price settings, holiday calendar settings, members CRUD (list/add/edit/delete), ticket sales history + member-count report.
3. Exact list of existing files to modify and what changes, per the branch points listed above.
4. A suggested nav structure change for `dashboard-shell.tsx` when businessType === 'tiket'.
5. Order of implementation (schema first, then reused-infra wiring, then new UI, then reports) and how to verify each step (what to check in Supabase dashboard after pasting the migration, what to click through in the browser preview).

Keep the plan concrete and scannable — exact file paths, not vague descriptions. Do not include code for every single file (that will be written during implementation), but DO include the full SQL for the migration since that's the highest-risk, hardest-to-fix-after-the-fact part.

# Implementation Plan: `tiket` Business Type (Venue/Attraction Ticketing)

## 0. Summary of approach

Add `'tiket'` as a third `business_type`. Build a fully separate data model (`ticket_categories`, `members`, `ticket_holidays`, `ticket_transactions`, `ticket_serials`) that parallels `products`/`transactions` but is not unified with them. Reuse `cashiers`, `shifts`, PIN auth, and the POS route-gating (`PinScreen`/`OpenShiftScreen`) verbatim. Add one new POS screen component, one settings sub-section (ticket categories + holidays), a `members` CRUD module, and one net-new report page for ticket sales/member counts. Existing product-centric pages (`products`, `ingredients`, `customers`, `finance` COGS math, `dashboard-shell` nav) get either hidden or left alone for `'tiket'` businesses — no attempt to unify `transactions` and `ticket_transactions` inside existing report pages.

```sql
-- Module: ticket venue business type ('tiket') — admission ticketing for
-- kolam renang / playground / tempat wisata. Distinct "kasir" model: not
-- products, but numbered admission tickets. Two configurable categories per
-- business (e.g. Pengunjung/Penunggu), each with its own continuous serial
-- sequence that never resets. Price depends on day type (weekday vs
-- weekend/manually-marked holiday) or member pricing. Reuses cashiers,
-- shifts, tax/service rate fields already on businesses — no new concepts
-- there.

-- Extend business_type to a third value. This migration is applied against
-- a live database where the original inline check constraint already exists
-- (auto-named businesses_business_type_check by Postgres) — drop and
-- recreate rather than editing 20260702100100_businesses_and_cashiers.sql
-- in place.
alter table public.businesses
  drop constraint if exists businesses_business_type_check;

alter table public.businesses
  add constraint businesses_business_type_check
  check (business_type in ('fnb', 'retail', 'tiket'));

-- Ticket categories -------------------------------------------------------
-- Configurable per business (owner names them, e.g. "Pengunjung",
-- "Penunggu"). Each category owns its own serial sequence via
-- ticket_categories.next_serial (never resets, never reused even on void).

create table public.ticket_categories (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  name text not null,
  price_weekday numeric(12, 2) not null default 0,
  price_holiday numeric(12, 2) not null default 0,
  member_price numeric(12, 2) not null default 0,
  serial_prefix text not null default '',
  next_serial int not null default 1,
  active boolean not null default true,
  deleted_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index ticket_categories_business_id_idx on public.ticket_categories (business_id);
create unique index ticket_categories_business_id_name_key
  on public.ticket_categories (business_id, name)
  where deleted_at is null;

alter table public.ticket_categories enable row level security;

create policy "Owner manages ticket categories of own businesses"
on public.ticket_categories for all
using (private.owns_business(business_id))
with check (private.owns_business(business_id));

-- Ticket serials (one row per physical ticket) -------------------------------
-- No separate line-items table: price/category are snapshotted directly on
-- each serial row since each row already *is* one ticket, one price line.
-- serial_no is unique per (business_id, ticket_category_id) — the
-- continuous, never-reset sequence promised to the owner. voided flag is
-- per-transaction (inherited via join) — serials themselves stay allocated
-- forever, matching a physically-printed ticket that was already handed out.

create table public.ticket_serials (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  ticket_transaction_id uuid not null references public.ticket_transactions (id) on delete cascade,
  ticket_category_id uuid not null references public.ticket_categories (id),
  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  serial_no int not null,
  price numeric(12, 2) not null,
  is_member_price boolean not null default false,
  member_id uuid references public.members (id) on delete set null,
  constraint ticket_serials_business_id_category_id_serial_no_key
    unique (business_id, ticket_category_id, serial_no)
);

create index ticket_serials_ticket_transaction_id_idx
  on public.ticket_serials (ticket_transaction_id);
create index ticket_serials_category_serial_idx
  on public.ticket_serials (ticket_category_id, serial_no);

alter table public.ticket_serials enable row level security;

create policy "Owner manages ticket serials of own transactions"
on public.ticket_serials for all
using (private.owns_business(business_id))
with check (private.owns_business(business_id));

-- checkout_ticket_transaction RPC ---------------------------------------------
-- p_items: array of {ticket_category_id, qty}. Loops per item, then per unit
-- of qty issues one ticket_serials row (serial_no = category.next_serial++).
-- Price resolution per unit: member (if p_member_id valid & active on
-- current date) -> member_price; else weekday/holiday price based on
-- p_is_holiday (server pre-computes this via is_holiday_date-equivalent
-- logic client-side/action-side, passed in explicitly so the RPC doesn't
-- need to know today's weekday/holiday rules itself... — actually compute
-- is_holiday INSIDE the RPC from ticket_holidays + extract(dow) for
-- correctness even if caller is stale).

create or replace function public.checkout_ticket_transaction(
  p_business_id uuid,
  p_cashier_id uuid,
  p_items jsonb, -- array of {ticket_category_id, qty}
  p_payment_method text,
  p_received numeric default null,
  p_member_id uuid default null
)
returns table (transaction_id uuid, invoice_number text)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_business record;
  v_member record;
  v_invoice_number text;
  v_seq int;
  v_is_holiday boolean;
  v_subtotal numeric(12, 2) := 0;
  v_service numeric(12, 2) := 0;
  v_tax numeric(12, 2) := 0;
  v_total numeric(12, 2);
  v_change numeric(12, 2);
  v_transaction_id uuid;
  v_shift_id uuid;
  v_item jsonb;
  v_category_id uuid;
  v_category record;
  v_qty int;
  v_use_member_price boolean;
  v_unit_price numeric(12, 2);
  v_serial int;
  i int;
begin
  if not private.owns_business(p_business_id) then
    raise exception 'not authorized';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.cashiers c
    where c.id = p_cashier_id and c.business_id = p_business_id and c.active
  ) then
    raise exception 'invalid cashier';
  end if;

  if p_payment_method is null or length(trim(p_payment_method)) = 0 then
    raise exception 'payment method required';
  end if;

  if p_items is null or jsonb_array_length(p_items) = 0 then
    raise exception 'cart is empty';
  end if;

  select b.tax_enabled, b.tax_rate, b.service_enabled, b.service_rate
  into v_business
  from public.businesses b
  where b.id = p_business_id;

  select id into v_shift_id
  from public.shifts
  where business_id = p_business_id and closed_at is null
  limit 1;

  if v_shift_id is null then
    raise exception 'no active shift — open a shift before selling';
  end if;

  -- Member validation: must belong to this business, not soft-deleted, and
  -- today (server clock, WIB not required here since valid_from/until are
  -- plain dates) within [valid_from, valid_until].
  v_use_member_price := false;
  if p_member_id is not null then
    select m.id, m.valid_from, m.valid_until
    into v_member
    from public.members m
    where m.id = p_member_id
      and m.business_id = p_business_id
      and m.deleted_at is null;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'member not found';
    end if;

    if current_date < v_member.valid_from or current_date > v_member.valid_until then
      raise exception 'membership tidak aktif (kadaluarsa atau belum berlaku)';
    end if;

    v_use_member_price := true;
  end if;

  -- Day-type: automatic weekend (Sat=6, Sun=0 per extract(dow)) OR a row in
  -- ticket_holidays for today.
  v_is_holiday := extract(dow from current_date) in (0, 6)
    or exists (
      select 1 from public.ticket_holidays h
      where h.business_id = p_business_id and h.holiday_date = current_date
    );

  select count(*) + 1 into v_seq
  from public.ticket_transactions t
  where t.business_id = p_business_id
    and t.date::date = current_date;

  v_invoice_number := 'TIX-' || to_char(current_date, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || lpad(v_seq::text, 4, '0');

  insert into public.ticket_transactions (
    business_id, shift_id, cashier_id, member_id, invoice_number, date,
    is_holiday, subtotal, service, tax, total, payment_method, received, change
  ) values (
    p_business_id, v_shift_id, p_cashier_id, p_member_id, v_invoice_number, now(),
    v_is_holiday, 0, 0, 0, 0, p_payment_method, p_received, 0
  )
  returning id into v_transaction_id;

  for v_item in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_items)
  loop
    v_category_id := (v_item ->> 'ticket_category_id')::uuid;
    v_qty := (v_item ->> 'qty')::int;

    if v_qty is null or v_qty <= 0 then
      raise exception 'invalid quantity';
    end if;

    -- Lock the category row so concurrent checkouts can't race on next_serial.
    select * into v_category
    from public.ticket_categories
    where id = v_category_id
      and business_id = p_business_id
      and deleted_at is null
    for update;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'ticket category not found: %', v_category_id;
    end if;

    v_unit_price := case
      when v_use_member_price then v_category.member_price
      when v_is_holiday then v_category.price_holiday
      else v_category.price_weekday
    end;

    for i in 1..v_qty loop
      v_serial := v_category.next_serial;

      insert into public.ticket_serials (
        ticket_transaction_id, ticket_category_id, business_id,
        serial_no, price, is_member_price, member_id
      ) values (
        v_transaction_id, v_category_id, p_business_id,
        v_serial, v_unit_price, v_use_member_price, p_member_id
      );

      v_category.next_serial := v_category.next_serial + 1;
      v_subtotal := v_subtotal + v_unit_price;
    end loop;

    update public.ticket_categories
    set next_serial = v_category.next_serial
    where id = v_category_id;
  end loop;

  if v_business.service_enabled then
    v_service := round(v_subtotal * v_business.service_rate / 100);
  end if;

  if v_business.tax_enabled then
    v_tax := round((v_subtotal + v_service) * v_business.tax_rate / 100);
  end if;

  v_total := v_subtotal + v_service + v_tax;
  v_change := greatest(coalesce(p_received, v_total) - v_total, 0);

  update public.ticket_transactions
  set subtotal = v_subtotal,
      service = v_service,
      tax = v_tax,
      total = v_total,
      change = v_change
  where id = v_transaction_id;

  return query select v_transaction_id, v_invoice_number;
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.checkout_ticket_transaction(uuid, uuid, jsonb, text, numeric, uuid) to authenticated;

-- void_ticket_transaction RPC ------------------------------------------------
-- Same manager-PIN-verification pattern as void_transaction. No stock to
-- restore — ticket serials stay permanently allocated (a printed ticket was
-- already handed out), just flip the voided flag on the header.

create or replace function public.void_ticket_transaction(
  p_business_id uuid,
  p_transaction_id uuid,
  p_manager_pin text,
  p_reason text default null
)
returns table (voided_by_name text)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_manager record;
  v_tx record;
begin
  if not private.owns_business(p_business_id) then
    raise exception 'not authorized';
  end if;

  select c.id, c.name
  into v_manager
  from public.cashiers c
  where c.business_id = p_business_id
    and c.role = 'manajer'
    and c.active
    and c.pin_hash = extensions.crypt(p_manager_pin, c.pin_hash)
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'PIN salah atau tidak memiliki otorisasi';
  end if;

  select t.id, t.voided
  into v_tx
  from public.ticket_transactions t
  where t.id = p_transaction_id
    and t.business_id = p_business_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'transaction not found';
  end if;

  if v_tx.voided then
    raise exception 'transaksi sudah dibatalkan';
  end if;

  update public.ticket_transactions
  set voided = true,
      voided_at = now(),
      void_reason = nullif(left(trim(p_reason), 200), ''),
      voided_by = v_manager.id
  where id = p_transaction_id;

  return query select v_manager.name;
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.void_ticket_transaction(uuid, uuid, text, text) to authenticated;
```

Notes baked into the design:
- `ticket_categories.next_serial` + `for update` row lock is how the "continuous sequence, never resets" requirement is made race-safe under concurrent checkouts (mirrors the count-based invoice numbering already accepted elsewhere in this codebase, but serials need real uniqueness guarantees since they'll be reconciled against physical tickets, hence the explicit counter column + unique index rather than a count(*) query).
- `is_holiday` is computed **inside** the RPC (not trusted from the client) so pricing can't be spoofed and stays correct even if the POS screen's local date logic is stale.
- Member price still allocates real serials (per requirement: "not a free pass with zero record").
- `ticket_serials.price` of `0` is valid (member gets free access) — no check constraint forcing `price > 0`.

# Implementation Plan: `tiket` Business Type (Venue/Attraction Ticketing)

## 0. Summary of approach

Add `'tiket'` as a third `business_type`. Build a fully separate data model (`ticket_categories`, `members`, `ticket_holidays`, `ticket_transactions`, `ticket_serials`) that parallels `products`/`transactions` but is not unified with them. Reuse `cashiers`, `shifts`, PIN auth, and the POS route-gating (`PinScreen`/`OpenShiftScreen`) verbatim. Add one new POS screen component, one settings sub-section (ticket categories + holidays), a `members` CRUD module, and one net-new report page for ticket sales/member counts. Existing product-centric pages (`products`, `ingredients`, `customers`, `finance` COGS math, `dashboard-shell` nav) get either hidden or left alone for `'tiket'` businesses — no attempt to unify `transactions` and `ticket_transactions` inside existing report pages.

## 1. Migration file

**Path:** `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\supabase\migrations\20260706200000_ticket_venue.sql`

Full SQL:

```sql
-- Module: ticket venue business type ('tiket') — admission ticketing for
-- kolam renang / playground / tempat wisata. Distinct "kasir" model: not
-- products, but numbered admission tickets. Two configurable categories per
-- business (e.g. Pengunjung/Penunggu), each with its own continuous serial
-- sequence that never resets. Price depends on day type (weekday vs
-- weekend/manually-marked holiday) or member pricing. Reuses cashiers,
-- shifts, tax/service rate fields already on businesses — no new concepts
-- there.

-- Extend business_type to a third value. This migration is applied against
-- a live database where the original inline check constraint already exists
-- (auto-named businesses_business_type_check by Postgres) — drop and
-- recreate rather than editing 20260702100100_businesses_and_cashiers.sql
-- in place.
alter table public.businesses
  drop constraint if exists businesses_business_type_check;

alter table public.businesses
  add constraint businesses_business_type_check
  check (business_type in ('fnb', 'retail', 'tiket'));

-- Ticket categories -------------------------------------------------------
-- Configurable per business (owner names them, e.g. "Pengunjung",
-- "Penunggu"). Each category owns its own serial sequence via
-- ticket_categories.next_serial (never resets, never reused even on void).

create table public.ticket_categories (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  name text not null,
  price_weekday numeric(12, 2) not null default 0,
  price_holiday numeric(12, 2) not null default 0,
  member_price numeric(12, 2) not null default 0,
  serial_prefix text not null default '',
  next_serial int not null default 1,
  active boolean not null default true,
  deleted_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index ticket_categories_business_id_idx on public.ticket_categories (business_id);
create unique index ticket_categories_business_id_name_key
  on public.ticket_categories (business_id, name)
  where deleted_at is null;

alter table public.ticket_categories enable row level security;

create policy "Owner manages ticket categories of own businesses"
on public.ticket_categories for all
using (private.owns_business(business_id))
with check (private.owns_business(business_id));

-- Ticket holidays -----------------------------------------------------------
-- Manually-flagged calendar dates (e.g. national holidays) that count as
-- "hari libur" pricing in addition to automatic Saturday/Sunday.

create table public.ticket_holidays (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  holiday_date date not null,
  label text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (business_id, holiday_date)
);

create index ticket_holidays_business_id_idx on public.ticket_holidays (business_id);

alter table public.ticket_holidays enable row level security;

create policy "Owner manages ticket holidays of own businesses"
on public.ticket_holidays for all
using (private.owns_business(business_id))
with check (private.owns_business(business_id));

-- Members -------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Subscription/card-based customers, distinct from the existing `customers`
-- table (which is walk-in purchase history, not a subscription concept).

create table public.members (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  member_code text not null,
  name text not null,
  phone text,
  valid_from date not null,
  valid_until date not null,
  note text,
  deleted_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index members_business_id_idx on public.members (business_id);
create unique index members_business_id_member_code_key
  on public.members (business_id, member_code)
  where deleted_at is null;

alter table public.members enable row level security;

create policy "Owner manages members of own businesses"
on public.members for all
using (private.owns_business(business_id))
with check (private.owns_business(business_id));

-- Ticket transactions (header) -----------------------------------------------
-- Mirrors public.transactions but for ticket sales. Kept as a fully separate
-- table (not unioned into `transactions`) — no COGS concept applies to
-- admission tickets, and existing report pages stay scoped to `transactions`.

create table public.ticket_transactions (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  shift_id uuid references public.shifts (id) on delete set null,
  cashier_id uuid not null references public.cashiers (id),
  member_id uuid references public.members (id) on delete set null,
  invoice_number text not null,
  date timestamptz not null default now(),
  is_holiday boolean not null default false,
  subtotal numeric(12, 2) not null default 0,
  service numeric(12, 2) not null default 0,
  tax numeric(12, 2) not null default 0,
  total numeric(12, 2) not null default 0,
  payment_method text not null,
  received numeric(12, 2),
  change numeric(12, 2),
  voided boolean not null default false,
  voided_at timestamptz,
  void_reason text,
  voided_by uuid references public.cashiers (id),
  constraint ticket_transactions_business_id_invoice_number_key
    unique (business_id, invoice_number)
);

create index ticket_transactions_business_id_date_idx
  on public.ticket_transactions (business_id, date);
create index ticket_transactions_shift_id_idx on public.ticket_transactions (shift_id);
create index ticket_transactions_member_id_idx on public.ticket_transactions (member_id);

alter table public.ticket_transactions enable row level security;

create policy "Owner manages ticket transactions of own businesses"
on public.ticket_transactions for all
using (private.owns_business(business_id))
with check (private.owns_business(business_id));

-- Ticket serials (one row per physical ticket) -------------------------------
-- No separate line-items table: price/category are snapshotted directly on
-- each serial row since each row already *is* one ticket, one price line.
-- serial_no is unique per (business_id, ticket_category_id) — the
-- continuous, never-reset sequence promised to the owner. voided flag is
-- per-transaction (inherited via join) — serials themselves stay allocated
-- forever, matching a physically-printed ticket that was already handed out.

create table public.ticket_serials (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  ticket_transaction_id uuid not null references public.ticket_transactions (id) on delete cascade,
  ticket_category_id uuid not null references public.ticket_categories (id),
  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  serial_no int not null,
  price numeric(12, 2) not null,
  is_member_price boolean not null default false,
  member_id uuid references public.members (id) on delete set null,
  constraint ticket_serials_business_id_category_id_serial_no_key
    unique (business_id, ticket_category_id, serial_no)
);

create index ticket_serials_ticket_transaction_id_idx
  on public.ticket_serials (ticket_transaction_id);
create index ticket_serials_category_serial_idx
  on public.ticket_serials (ticket_category_id, serial_no);

alter table public.ticket_serials enable row level security;

create policy "Owner manages ticket serials of own transactions"
on public.ticket_serials for all
using (private.owns_business(business_id))
with check (private.owns_business(business_id));

-- checkout_ticket_transaction RPC ---------------------------------------------
-- p_items: array of {ticket_category_id, qty}. Loops per item, then per unit
-- of qty issues one ticket_serials row (serial_no = category.next_serial++).
-- Price resolution per unit: member (if p_member_id valid & active on
-- current date) -> member_price; else weekday/holiday price based on
-- p_is_holiday (server pre-computes this via is_holiday_date-equivalent
-- logic client-side/action-side, passed in explicitly so the RPC doesn't
-- need to know today's weekday/holiday rules itself... — actually compute
-- is_holiday INSIDE the RPC from ticket_holidays + extract(dow) for
-- correctness even if caller is stale).

create or replace function public.checkout_ticket_transaction(
  p_business_id uuid,
  p_cashier_id uuid,
  p_items jsonb, -- array of {ticket_category_id, qty}
  p_payment_method text,
  p_received numeric default null,
  p_member_id uuid default null
)
returns table (transaction_id uuid, invoice_number text)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_business record;
  v_member record;
  v_invoice_number text;
  v_seq int;
  v_is_holiday boolean;
  v_subtotal numeric(12, 2) := 0;
  v_service numeric(12, 2) := 0;
  v_tax numeric(12, 2) := 0;
  v_total numeric(12, 2);
  v_change numeric(12, 2);
  v_transaction_id uuid;
  v_shift_id uuid;
  v_item jsonb;
  v_category_id uuid;
  v_category record;
  v_qty int;
  v_use_member_price boolean;
  v_unit_price numeric(12, 2);
  v_serial int;
  i int;
begin
  if not private.owns_business(p_business_id) then
    raise exception 'not authorized';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.cashiers c
    where c.id = p_cashier_id and c.business_id = p_business_id and c.active
  ) then
    raise exception 'invalid cashier';
  end if;

  if p_payment_method is null or length(trim(p_payment_method)) = 0 then
    raise exception 'payment method required';
  end if;

  if p_items is null or jsonb_array_length(p_items) = 0 then
    raise exception 'cart is empty';
  end if;

  select b.tax_enabled, b.tax_rate, b.service_enabled, b.service_rate
  into v_business
  from public.businesses b
  where b.id = p_business_id;

  select id into v_shift_id
  from public.shifts
  where business_id = p_business_id and closed_at is null
  limit 1;

  if v_shift_id is null then
    raise exception 'no active shift — open a shift before selling';
  end if;

  -- Member validation: must belong to this business, not soft-deleted, and
  -- today (server clock, WIB not required here since valid_from/until are
  -- plain dates) within [valid_from, valid_until].
  v_use_member_price := false;
  if p_member_id is not null then
    select m.id, m.valid_from, m.valid_until
    into v_member
    from public.members m
    where m.id = p_member_id
      and m.business_id = p_business_id
      and m.deleted_at is null;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'member not found';
    end if;

    if current_date < v_member.valid_from or current_date > v_member.valid_until then
      raise exception 'membership tidak aktif (kadaluarsa atau belum berlaku)';
    end if;

    v_use_member_price := true;
  end if;

  -- Day-type: automatic weekend (Sat=6, Sun=0 per extract(dow)) OR a row in
  -- ticket_holidays for today.
  v_is_holiday := extract(dow from current_date) in (0, 6)
    or exists (
      select 1 from public.ticket_holidays h
      where h.business_id = p_business_id and h.holiday_date = current_date
    );

  select count(*) + 1 into v_seq
  from public.ticket_transactions t
  where t.business_id = p_business_id
    and t.date::date = current_date;

  v_invoice_number := 'TIX-' || to_char(current_date, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || lpad(v_seq::text, 4, '0');

  insert into public.ticket_transactions (
    business_id, shift_id, cashier_id, member_id, invoice_number, date,
    is_holiday, subtotal, service, tax, total, payment_method, received, change
  ) values (
    p_business_id, v_shift_id, p_cashier_id, p_member_id, v_invoice_number, now(),
    v_is_holiday, 0, 0, 0, 0, p_payment_method, p_received, 0
  )
  returning id into v_transaction_id;

  for v_item in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_items)
  loop
    v_category_id := (v_item ->> 'ticket_category_id')::uuid;
    v_qty := (v_item ->> 'qty')::int;

    if v_qty is null or v_qty <= 0 then
      raise exception 'invalid quantity';
    end if;

    -- Lock the category row so concurrent checkouts can't race on next_serial.
    select * into v_category
    from public.ticket_categories
    where id = v_category_id
      and business_id = p_business_id
      and deleted_at is null
    for update;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'ticket category not found: %', v_category_id;
    end if;

    v_unit_price := case
      when v_use_member_price then v_category.member_price
      when v_is_holiday then v_category.price_holiday
      else v_category.price_weekday
    end;

    for i in 1..v_qty loop
      v_serial := v_category.next_serial;

      insert into public.ticket_serials (
        ticket_transaction_id, ticket_category_id, business_id,
        serial_no, price, is_member_price, member_id
      ) values (
        v_transaction_id, v_category_id, p_business_id,
        v_serial, v_unit_price, v_use_member_price, p_member_id
      );

      v_category.next_serial := v_category.next_serial + 1;
      v_subtotal := v_subtotal + v_unit_price;
    end loop;

    update public.ticket_categories
    set next_serial = v_category.next_serial
    where id = v_category_id;
  end loop;

  if v_business.service_enabled then
    v_service := round(v_subtotal * v_business.service_rate / 100);
  end if;

  if v_business.tax_enabled then
    v_tax := round((v_subtotal + v_service) * v_business.tax_rate / 100);
  end if;

  v_total := v_subtotal + v_service + v_tax;
  v_change := greatest(coalesce(p_received, v_total) - v_total, 0);

  update public.ticket_transactions
  set subtotal = v_subtotal,
      service = v_service,
      tax = v_tax,
      total = v_total,
      change = v_change
  where id = v_transaction_id;

  return query select v_transaction_id, v_invoice_number;
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.checkout_ticket_transaction(uuid, uuid, jsonb, text, numeric, uuid) to authenticated;

-- void_ticket_transaction RPC ------------------------------------------------
-- Same manager-PIN-verification pattern as void_transaction. No stock to
-- restore — ticket serials stay permanently allocated (a printed ticket was
-- already handed out), just flip the voided flag on the header.

create or replace function public.void_ticket_transaction(
  p_business_id uuid,
  p_transaction_id uuid,
  p_manager_pin text,
  p_reason text default null
)
returns table (voided_by_name text)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_manager record;
  v_tx record;
begin
  if not private.owns_business(p_business_id) then
    raise exception 'not authorized';
  end if;

  select c.id, c.name
  into v_manager
  from public.cashiers c
  where c.business_id = p_business_id
    and c.role = 'manajer'
    and c.active
    and c.pin_hash = extensions.crypt(p_manager_pin, c.pin_hash)
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'PIN salah atau tidak memiliki otorisasi';
  end if;

  select t.id, t.voided
  into v_tx
  from public.ticket_transactions t
  where t.id = p_transaction_id
    and t.business_id = p_business_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'transaction not found';
  end if;

  if v_tx.voided then
    raise exception 'transaksi sudah dibatalkan';
  end if;

  update public.ticket_transactions
  set voided = true,
      voided_at = now(),
      void_reason = nullif(left(trim(p_reason), 200), ''),
      voided_by = v_manager.id
  where id = p_transaction_id;

  return query select v_manager.name;
end;
$$;

grant execute on function public.void_ticket_transaction(uuid, uuid, text, text) to authenticated;
```

Notes baked into the design:
- `ticket_categories.next_serial` + `for update` row lock is how the "continuous sequence, never resets" requirement is made race-safe under concurrent checkouts (mirrors the count-based invoice numbering already accepted elsewhere in this codebase, but serials need real uniqueness guarantees since they'll be reconciled against physical tickets, hence the explicit counter column + unique index rather than a count(*) query).
- `is_holiday` is computed **inside** the RPC (not trusted from the client) so pricing can't be spoofed and stays correct even if the POS screen's local date logic is stale.
- Member price still allocates real serials (per requirement: "not a free pass with zero record").
- `ticket_serials.price` of `0` is valid (member gets free access) — no check constraint forcing `price > 0`.

---
name: test-account-preview
description: Throwaway Supabase account + seeded data for verifying KasirKu pages in the browser preview
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 802b861c-e6dc-4eab-9b43-de12849efe70
---

For browser-preview verification of KasirKu (created 2026-07-03): test login `claude.test.reports@gmail.com` / `test-kasirku-123` (email confirmation is disabled on the Supabase project, signup returns a session immediately). Business "Toko Test Laporan" (F&B, id `7c483432-1c9a-4f03-a0b2-aa4d89f7f5e9`) with cashier "Melan" PIN `1234`, manager "Manajer Test" PIN `9999` (for void authorization), PPN 10% + service 5% enabled (affects checkout totals), products Kopi Susu/Roti Bakar, an open shift, 2 transactions on 2026-07-03, and table "Meja 1" (qr_slug `CWsFCMmosD7O`, id `8b67c355-65a2-47d3-a79a-a935ede87dd3`) for self-order testing. Self-orders can be seeded directly via REST insert into `self_orders` + `self_order_items` using the owner access token from the browser cookie (`sb-…-auth-token`, base64 JSON) since the customer-facing RPC is still missing on remote (see [[supabase-migrations-manual]]). Safe to reuse or delete — it's a separate auth user, invisible to the real owner account.

**Why:** the real owner's password is unknown, and the proxy redirects all /business routes to /login, so preview verification needs its own account.

**How to apply:** log in at /login with these credentials, then navigate to /business/<id>/... pages. Note: Turbopack on the slow G: drive sometimes serves stale CSS after globals.css edits — `rm -rf .next` and restart the dev server if new Tailwind utilities don't apply. See [[supabase-migrations-manual]].

content.text:
Selesai implementasi fitur kasir tiket. Ringkasan:

**Sudah dikerjakan & diverifikasi:**
- Migration lengkap ditulis di `supabase/migrations/20260706200000_ticket_venue.sql` (5 tabel baru + 2 RPC `checkout_ticket_transaction`/`void_ticket_transaction`)
- Semua kode UI/server actions untuk: onboarding radio "Tempat Wisata", nav sidebar 3-arah, POS jual tiket (kategori, member, hari kerja/libur, bayar), Pengaturan kategori & harga tiket + kalender libur, CRUD Anggota (member), Laporan Tiket (jumlah member aktif + rekonsiliasi per nomor seri)
- `npx tsc --noEmit` dan `eslint` bersih tanpa error
- Diverifikasi langsung di browser preview dengan akun test yang sudah punya bisnis F&B: dashboard, sidebar nav (F&B masih lengkap: Kelola Produk/Bahan Baku/Meja/dst tidak hilang), halaman Pengaturan, dan alur PIN kasir **tidak ada regresi sama sekali**

**Yang masih memblokir verifikasi penuh alur tiket:**
Migration belum diterapkan ke database live Supabase Anda (sesuai kebiasaan project ini — CLI belum di-link, jadi harus paste manual). Tanpa ini, tabel `ticket_categories`/`members`/`ticket_transactions`/dll belum ada, jadi saya belum bisa uji coba benar-benar jual tiket, tambah member, dsb secara end-to-end.

**Langkah Anda:** buka Supabase Dashboard → SQL Editor project Anda → paste seluruh isi `supabase/migrations/20260706200000_ticket_venue.sql` → Run. Setelah itu beri tahu saya, saya lanjutkan verifikasi penuh: bikin bisnis baru tipe "Tempat Wisata", isi kategori tiket, jual tiket dengan/tanpa member, cek laporan.

Satu hal yang perlu Anda ketahui soal desain (sudah saya catat di plan): kalau member datang bareng non-member dalam satu transaksi, harga member berlaku untuk **semua** tiket di keranjang itu — bukan cuma milik si member. Kalau perlu dipisah per orang, kasir harus split jadi 2 transaksi. Kabari kalau ini perlu diubah.

input.description: Check businesses table schema for required columns

content.content:
-- Module 1: businesses, cashiers — foundation for auth & access.

create table public.businesses (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  owner_id uuid not null references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
  name text not null,
  business_type text not null check (business_type in ('fnb', 'retail')),
  address text,
  phone text,
  npwp text,
  logo_url text,
  tax_enabled boolean not null default false,
  tax_rate numeric(5, 2) not null default 0,
  service_enabled boolean not null default false,
  service_rate numeric(5, 2) not null default 0,
  auto_lock_enabled boolean not null default true,
  auto_lock_minutes int not null default 5,
  recovery_code_hash text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

Semua verifikasi selesai dengan hasil sangat baik. Ringkasan:

**End-to-end teruji sukses** (pakai bisnis test "Kolam Renang Test"):
- Bisnis tiket baru → badge & nav 3-arah benar, quick-links sesuai (Laporan Tiket, Anggota, tanpa Kelola Produk)
- Pengaturan → tambah 2 kategori (Pengunjung Rp25rb/35rb, Penunggu Rp10rb/15rb) tersimpan benar
- Kasir baru (role Manajer) → buka kasir → checkout 2 Pengunjung + 1 Penunggu → total Rp60.000, kembalian benar
- Cek database: `ticket_serials` dapat nomor seri 1,2 (Pengunjung) dan 1 (Penunggu), `next_serial` naik jadi 3 dan 2 — sequence kontinu bekerja
- Tambah member "Budi Member" → checkout pakai kode member → harga otomatis jadi Rp0, tiket tetap dapat nomor seri #3 dengan flag `is_member_price=true` — sesuai requirement "bukan free pass tanpa catatan"
- Laporan Tiket → KPI anggota aktif (1), tiket terjual (4), pendapatan (Rp60rb), ringkasan per kategori, rekonsiliasi per nomor seri, filter kategori — semua akurat
- Dashboard utama bisnis tiket → pendapatan ambil dari `ticket_transactions`, bukan kosong

**1 bug ditemukan & diperbaiki selama pengujian:** tombol +/- qty tiket bisa kehilangan hitungan kalau diklik cepat berturut-turut (closure basi pada nilai qty). Sudah diperbaiki jadi pakai functional state update yang benar.

**1 gap ditutup:** RPC `void_ticket_transaction` sudah dibuat di migration tapi lupa dikasih tombol UI. Sekarang ada tombol "Void" di halaman Laporan Tiket (butuh PIN manajer) — sudah dites, berhasil membatalkan transaksi dan laporan otomatis mengecualikannya dari total.

Fitur kasir tiket sudah siap dipakai. Semua kode lolos `tsc` dan `eslint` tanpa error.

Berdasarkan fitur kasir tiket yang baru dibangun, ini yang menurut saya masih kurang — saya urutkan dari yang paling mungkin kebutuhan nyata ke yang lebih "nice to have":

**Cukup penting:**
1. **Tidak ada halaman detail per transaksi tiket** — beda dari F&B/Retail yang punya `/transactions/[id]` buat lihat & cetak struk satu transaksi. Tiket cuma bisa dilihat lewat daftar rekonsiliasi di Laporan Tiket, tidak ada tampilan struk/tiket yang bisa dicetak/discan pelanggan.
2. **Tidak ada cetak tiket fisik** — F&B punya cetak struk print-friendly; tiket belum punya tampilan tiket (misal dengan QR code) yang bisa dicetak atau ditunjukkan ke petugas pintu masuk untuk validasi.
3. **Menu Keuangan/Laporan/Laba-Rugi disembunyikan total dari sidebar untuk bisnis tiket** — padahal tabel `expenses` sebenarnya generik dan masih bisa dipakai (halaman `/finance` masih bisa diakses langsung via URL, cuma linknya saya hilangkan dari nav). Owner nggak ada cara gampang buat catat pengeluaran (listrik, gaji tambahan, dll) khusus tiket.
4. **Member + non-member campur dalam 1 transaksi** — sudah saya catat di awal: harga member berlaku untuk semua tiket di keranjang itu, bukan cuma milik si member. Kalau di lapangan sering campur, ini perlu diperbaiki jadi per-item.

**Kurang penting tapi lumayan kepakai:**
5. Halaman Anggota tidak ada pencarian/filter (beda dari halaman Pelanggan/Produk yang ada search).
6. Tidak ada export CSV untuk Laporan Tiket (F&B punya export penjualan & transaksi).
7. Tidak ada validasi kapasitas/kuota harian (misal maksimal 200 pengunjung/hari) — umum di tempat wisata tapi belum diminta.
8. Tidak ada diskon di kasir tiket (F&B/Retail punya diskon per-item & per-order).

**Di luar fitur tiket (gap lama, bukan dari kerjaan ini):**
9. Info toko (alamat, telepon, NPWP, logo) belum ada UI-nya untuk semua jenis bisnis.
10. Kasir belum ada auto-lock/recovery-PIN kalau lupa.

Mau saya kerjakan salah satu dari ini duluan? Yang paling saya sarankan: **#1+#2 (detail transaksi + cetak tiket)** karena itu yang paling kelihatan "belum lengkap" buat operasional harian di lapangan.

Item #1 selesai dan teruji penuh. Ringkasan yang ditambahkan:

- **`ticket-reports/[transactionId]/page.tsx`** — halaman detail transaksi tiket: invoice, tanggal, kasir, member (kalau ada), badge hari kerja/libur, daftar tiket per nomor seri, rincian pembayaran, dan status void.
- **`ticket-reports/[transactionId]/void-ticket-transaction-form.tsx`** — form void PIN manajer + alasan langsung di halaman detail (dipindah dari popup inline di daftar laporan).
- **`ticket-reports/[transactionId]/receipt/`** — struk cetak-ramah (gaya monospace sama seperti F&B), dengan tombol Kembali/Cetak.
- Baris di Laporan Tiket sekarang jadi link ke halaman detail (dulu cuma teks statis + tombol void mengambang).

input.prompt:
This is the KasirKu POS app (Next.js App Router + Supabase, at G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu). In an earlier session I built a "tiket" business type (venue ticketing: kolam renang/wisata) — numbered admission tickets per category (e.g. Pengunjung/Penunggu), weekday/holiday pricing, and a membership system. That work is already committed (commits 5719374 and f59331c). The user now wants 4 additional things added to that same feature, and I already asked clarifying questions and got clear answers. Do NOT write any code — produce a concrete, reviewable implementation plan only.

## Ground truth (verified by me already, treat as fact)

**Current checkout RPC** — `supabase/migrations/20260706200000_ticket_venue.sql` defines `checkout_ticket_transaction(p_business_id uuid, p_cashier_id uuid, p_items jsonb, p_payment_method text, p_received numeric default null, p_member_id uuid default null)`. `p_items` is currently `[{ticket_category_id, qty}]`. Inside, it loops items, locks the `ticket_categories` row `for update`, computes `v_unit_price` (member price if member selected, else weekday/holiday price computed from `extract(dow from current_date)` + a `ticket_holidays` table lookup), then loops `for i in 1..v_qty` inserting one `ticket_serials` row per unit with `serial_no := v_category.next_serial` (incrementing a persistent counter column on `ticket_categories`, continuous, never reset, race-safe via the row lock). Same migration also has `void_ticket_transaction(p_business_id, p_transaction_id, p_manager_pin, p_reason)` — manager-PIN verified via `extensions.crypt`, just flips `voided`/`voided_at`/`void_reason`/`voided_by`, does not touch serials.

**Tables**: `ticket_categories` (id, business_id, name, price_weekday, price_holiday, member_price, next_serial int, active, deleted_at), `ticket_holidays` (business_id, holiday_date, label), `members` (id, business_id, member_code text unique-per-business-when-not-deleted, name, phone, valid_from date, valid_until date, note, deleted_at), `ticket_transactions` (header: business_id, shift_id, cashier_id, member_id, invoice_number, date, is_holiday, subtotal, service, tax, total, payment_method, received, change, voided/voided_at/void_reason/voided_by), `ticket_serials` (one row per physical ticket: ticket_transaction_id, ticket_category_id, business_id, serial_no int, price, is_member_price — unique on (business_id, ticket_category_id, serial_no)).

**Client wrapper** `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/ticket-actions.ts`: `checkoutTicket(businessId, cashierId, items: {ticketCategoryId, qty}[], paymentMethod, received, memberId)` calls the RPC mapping `items` to `{ticket_category_id, qty}`. Also has `lookupMemberByCode(businessId, code)` (exact-match query on `members.member_code`, validates today is within `valid_from`/`valid_until`) and `voidTicketTransaction(businessId, transactionId, managerPin, reason)`.

**POS screen** `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/ticket-pos-screen.tsx`: client component. Cart state is `qtyByCategory: Record<categoryId, number>`, with a `changeQty(categoryId, delta)` functional-update helper (I already fixed a stale-closure bug here — must keep using the functional-update pattern for any new cart state). Each category renders as a card with a `−`/count/`+` stepper. There's a "Member (opsional)" box: a text input for member code + "Cari" button calling `lookupMemberByCode`, showing the found member with a "Lepas" (release) button. Below that, category cards, then a cart/payment sidebar (payment method buttons, received amount, confirm). `isHoliday` and `categories` (with priceWeekday/priceHoliday/memberPrice) are passed in as props from the server page.

**Server page** `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/page.tsx`: for `business.business_type === "tiket"`, fetches `ticket_categories` (active, not deleted) and `custom_payment_methods`, computes `isHoliday` server-side (weekday check + `ticket_holidays` lookup for today), renders `<TicketPosScreen>`. Does NOT currently fetch the members list.

**Members back-office CRUD** already exists at `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/members/`: `page.tsx` (list), `actions.ts` (`addMember(businessId, prevState, formData)`, `editMember`, `deleteMember` — all plain exported server actions, reusable from anywhere, not route-bound), `add-member-form.tsx` (client form component using `useActionState`), `[memberId]/page.tsx` (detail), `[memberId]/edit-member-form.tsx`, `[memberId]/delete-member-button.tsx`.

**Ticket reports** `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/ticket-reports/page.tsx`: server component, lists one row per `ticket_serials` joined to its `ticket_transactions` (invoice, date, category, serial_no, price, member flag, voided), with period/category/serial-range filters (reusing `../reports/period.ts`'s `parsePeriod`/`getPeriodRange`/`PERIOD_LABELS`/`PERIOD_DESCRIPTIONS`), plus a KPI section (active member count, tickets sold, revenue) and a per-category summary. Rows are `<Link>`s to `ticket-reports/[transactionId]/page.tsx` (detail page — shows full breakdown, cashier, member, day-type, void form) which links to `ticket-reports/[transactionId]/receipt/page.tsx` (printable receipt, monospace, `window.print()`).
